(γάμος),

1063:
**γάρ**, 
_co-ordinating particle_, contr. of γε ἄρα, 
**verily then**, hence, **in truth, indeed, yea, then, why**, and when giving a reason or explanation, **for**, the usage in NT being in general accord with that of cl.; 
1. **explicative and epexegetic**: [[40-matthew.4.18|Mat.4:18 19:12]], [[41-mark.1.16|Mrk.1:16 5:42 16:4]], [[42-luke.11.3|Luk.11:3]]o, [[45-romans.7.1|Rom.7:1]], [[46-1-corinthians.16.5|1Co.16:5]], al. 
2. **Conclusive, in questions, answers and exclamations**: [[40-matthew.9.5|Mat.9:5 27:23]], [[42-luke.9.25|Luk.9:25 22:27]], [[43-john.9.30|Jhn.9:30]], [[44-acts.8.31|Act.8:31 16:37 19:35]], [[45-romans.15.26|Rom.15:26]], [[46-1-corinthians.9.10|1Co.9:10]], [[50-philippians.1.18|Php.1:18]] (Ellic., in l.), [[52-1-thessalonians.2.20|1Th.2:20]], al. 
3. **Causal**: [[40-matthew.1.21|Mat.1:21 2:2, 5, 6, 3:23]], [[41-mark.1.22|Mrk.1:22, 9:6]], [[42-luke.1.15|Luk.1:15, 18]], [[43-john.2.25|Jhn.2:25]], [[44-acts.2.25|Act.2:25]], [[45-romans.1.9|Rom.1:9, 11]], [[46-1-corinthians.11.5|1Co.11:5]], [[66-revelation.1.3|Rev.1:3]], al.; giving the reason for a command or prohibition, [[40-matthew.2.20|Mat.2:20 3:9]], [[45-romans.13.11|Rom.13:11]], [[51-colossians.3.3|Col.3:3]], [[52-1-thessalonians.4.3|1Th.4:3]], al.; where the cause is contained in an interrog. statement, [[42-luke.22.27|Luk.22:27]], [[45-romans.3.3|Rom.3:3 4:3]], [[46-1-corinthians.10.29|1Co.10:29]]; καὶ γάρ, **for also**, [[41-mark.10.45|Mrk.10:45]], [[42-luke.6.32|Luk.6:32]], [[46-1-corinthians.5.7|1Co.5:7]], al. id. as in cl. = etenim, where the καί loses its connective force (Bl., §78, 6; Kühner 3, ii, 854f.), [[41-mark.14.70|Mrk.14:70]], [[42-luke.1.66|Luk.1:66 22:37]], [[47-2-corinthians.13.4|2Co.13:4]]. The proper place of γάρ is after the first word in a clause, but in poets it often comes third or fourth, and so in late prose: [[47-2-corinthians.1.19|2Co.1:19.]] Yet "not the number but the nature of the word after which it stands is the point to be noticed" (see Thayer, see word).
(AS)

1473:
**ἐγώ**, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς, 
_of person(s) pron._ 
**I**. 
(a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in [[40-matthew.3.11|Mat.3:11]], [[41-mark.1.8|Mrk.1:8]], [[42-luke.3.16|Luk.3:16]], al. (like Heb. אֲנִי), **I am**, [[43-john.1.23|Jhn.1:23]] (LXX), [[44-acts.7.32|Act.7:32]] (LXX). 
(b) The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, [[43-john.14.20|Jhn.14:20;]] μου τ. λόγους, [[40-matthew.7.24|Mat.7:24;]] ὀπίσω μου, [[40-matthew.3.11|Mat.3:11;]] ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, [[66-revelation.5.5|Rev.5:5;]] also with the prep. πρός, as [[41-mark.9.19|Mrk.9:19]], al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as [[42-luke.10.16|Luk.10:16]], [[43-john.7.23|Jhn.7:23]], [[41-mark.14.7|Mrk.14:7]], al. 
(with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, [[40-matthew.2.6|Mat.2:6;]] μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, [[41-mark.9.24|Mrk.9:24.]] 
(d) τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, [[07-judges.11.12|Jdg.11:12]], al.), i.e. **what have we in common**: [[40-matthew.8.29|Mat.8:29]], [[41-mark.1.24|Mrk.1:24, 5:7]], [[42-luke.8.28|Luk.8:28]], [[43-john.2.4|Jhn.2:4]]; τί γάρ μοι, [[46-1-corinthians.5.2|1Co.5:2.]] 
(e) The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, _Pr._, 86f., M, _Th._, 131f.).
(f) κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ), **and I, even I, I also**: [[40-matthew.2.8|Mat.2:8]], [[42-luke.2.48|Luk.2:48]], [[43-john.6.56|Jhn.6:56]], [[45-romans.3.7|Rom.3:7]], [[46-1-corinthians.7.40|1Co.7:40]], al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, **both . . . and**, [[43-john.7.28|Jhn.7:28.]]

1487G:
**εἰ**, 
_conjunctive particle_, used in conditions and in indirect questions. 
I. Conditional, **if**; 
1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; 
(a) pres.: before indic, pres., [[40-matthew.11.14|Mat.11:14]], [[45-romans.8.25|Rom.8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[41-mark.4.23|Mrk.4:23 9:22]], [[43-john.15.18|Jhn.15:18]], [[46-1-corinthians.7.9|1Co.7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[42-luke.16.31|Luk.16:31]], [[45-romans.8.11|Rom.8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[40-matthew.12.26|Mat.12:26]], [[45-romans.4.14|Rom.4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[42-luke.17.6|Luk.17:6]], [[43-john.8.39|Jhn.8:39]]; before quæst., [[40-matthew.6.23|Mat.6:23]], [[43-john.5.47|Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[60-1-peter.2.20|1Pe.2:20]]; 
(b) fut.: [[40-matthew.26.33|Mat.26:33]], [[60-1-peter.2.20|1Pe.2:20]]; 
(with) pf.: [[43-john.11.12|Jhn.11:12]], [[45-romans.6.5|Rom.6:5]], al.; 
(d) aor.: [[42-luke.16.11|Luk.16:11 19:8]], [[43-john.13.32|Jhn.13:32, 18:23]], [[66-revelation.20.15|Rev.20:15]], al. 
2. **Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί**: [[40-matthew.12.28|Mat.12:28]], [[43-john.7.4|Jhn.7:4]], [[45-romans.5.17|Rom.5:17]], al. 
3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i). 
4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: [[41-mark.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[62-1-john.3.13|1Jn.3:13]], al. 
5. C. indic., as in LXX ([[04-numbers.14.3|Num.14:3]]o, [[09-1-samuel.14.45|1Ki.14:45]], al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): [[41-mark.8.12|Mrk.8:12]], [[58-hebrews.3.11|Heb.3:11]]" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX). 
6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, **to express a merely possible condition**: [[44-acts.24.19|Act.24:19 27:39]], [[46-1-corinthians.14.10|1Co.14:10 15:37]], I Pe3:14, 17. 
II. Interrogative, **if, whether**. 
1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[40-matthew.26.63|Mat.26:63]], [[41-mark.15.36|Mrk.15:36]], [[44-acts.19.2|Act.19:2]], [[47-2-corinthians.13.5|2Co.13:5]], al.; fut., [[41-mark.3.2|Mrk.3:2]], [[44-acts.8.22|Act.8:22]], al.; aor., [[41-mark.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[46-1-corinthians.1.16|1Co.1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, _Pr._, 194), [[50-philippians.3.12|Php.3:12.]] 
2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, [[01-genesis.17.17|Gen.17:17]], al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), **in direct questions**: [[41-mark.8.23|Mrk.8:23]] (Tr., WH, txt.), [[42-luke.13.23|Luk.13:23, 22:49]], [[44-acts.19.2|Act.19:2]], al.
III. With other particles. 
1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε. 
2. εἰ δὲ καί, **but if also**: [[42-luke.11.18|Luk.11:18;]] **but even if**, [[46-1-corinthians.4.7|1Co.4:7]], [[47-2-corinthians.4.3|2Co.4:3 11:16]]. 
3. εἰ δὲ μή, **but if not, but if otherwise**: [[41-mark.2.21|Mrk.2:21, 22]] [[43-john.14.2|Jhn.14:2]], [[66-revelation.2.5|Rev.2:5]], al. 
4. εἰ καί, **if even, if also, although**: [[41-mark.14.29|Mrk.14:29]], [[42-luke.11.8|Luk.11:8]], [[46-1-corinthians.7.21|1Co.7:21]], [[47-2-corinthians.4.16|2Co.4:16]], [[50-philippians.2.17|Php.2:17]], al. 
5. καὶ εἰ, **even if**, see: καί 
6. εἰ μή, **if not, unless, except, but only**: [[40-matthew.24.22|Mat.24:22]], [[41-mark.2.26|Mrk.2:26 6:5]], [[43-john.9.33|Jhn.9:33]], [[46-1-corinthians.7.17|1Co.7:17]] (**only**), [[48-galatians.1.19|Gal.1:19]] (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., _Ja._, xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), [[46-1-corinthians.14.5|1Co.14:5 15:2]], [[54-1-timothy.5.19|1Ti.5:19]]. 
7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, _Pr._, 46), in oaths, **surely** ([[26-ezekiel.33.27|Eze.33:27]], al.): [[58-hebrews.6.14|Heb.6:14]]. 
8. εἴ πως, **if haply**: [[44-acts.27.12|Act.27:12]], [[45-romans.1.10|Rom.1:10]]. 
9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, **whether . . . or**; [[45-romans.12.6|Rom.12:6-8]], [[46-1-corinthians.3.22|1Co.3:22 13:8]], al.

1487M:
**εἰ**, 
_conjunctive particle_, used in conditions and in indirect questions. 
I. Conditional, **if**; 
1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; 
(a) pres.: before indic, pres., [[40-matthew.11.14|Mat.11:14]], [[45-romans.8.25|Rom.8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[41-mark.4.23|Mrk.4:23 9:22]], [[43-john.15.18|Jhn.15:18]], [[46-1-corinthians.7.9|1Co.7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[42-luke.16.31|Luk.16:31]], [[45-romans.8.11|Rom.8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[40-matthew.12.26|Mat.12:26]], [[45-romans.4.14|Rom.4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[42-luke.17.6|Luk.17:6]], [[43-john.8.39|Jhn.8:39]]; before quæst., [[40-matthew.6.23|Mat.6:23]], [[43-john.5.47|Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[60-1-peter.2.20|1Pe.2:20]]; 
(b) fut.: [[40-matthew.26.33|Mat.26:33]], [[60-1-peter.2.20|1Pe.2:20]]; 
(with) pf.: [[43-john.11.12|Jhn.11:12]], [[45-romans.6.5|Rom.6:5]], al.; 
(d) aor.: [[42-luke.16.11|Luk.16:11 19:8]], [[43-john.13.32|Jhn.13:32, 18:23]], [[66-revelation.20.15|Rev.20:15]], al. 
2. **Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί**: [[40-matthew.12.28|Mat.12:28]], [[43-john.7.4|Jhn.7:4]], [[45-romans.5.17|Rom.5:17]], al. 
3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i). 
4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: [[41-mark.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[62-1-john.3.13|1Jn.3:13]], al. 
5. C. indic., as in LXX ([[04-numbers.14.3|Num.14:3]]o, [[09-1-samuel.14.45|1Ki.14:45]], al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): [[41-mark.8.12|Mrk.8:12]], [[58-hebrews.3.11|Heb.3:11]]" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX). 
6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, **to express a merely possible condition**: [[44-acts.24.19|Act.24:19 27:39]], [[46-1-corinthians.14.10|1Co.14:10 15:37]], I Pe3:14, 17.

As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[40-matthew.26.63|Mat.26:63]], [[41-mark.15.36|Mrk.15:36]], [[44-acts.19.2|Act.19:2]], [[47-2-corinthians.13.5|2Co.13:5]], al.; fut., [[41-mark.3.2|Mrk.3:2]], [[44-acts.8.22|Act.8:22]], al.; aor., [[41-mark.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[46-1-corinthians.1.16|1Co.1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, _Pr._, 194), [[50-philippians.3.12|Php.3:12.]]

6. εἰ μή, **if not, unless, except, but only**: [[40-matthew.24.22|Mat.24:22]], [[41-mark.2.26|Mrk.2:26 6:5]], [[43-john.9.33|Jhn.9:33]], [[46-1-corinthians.7.17|1Co.7:17]] (**only**), [[48-galatians.1.19|Gal.1:19]] (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., _Ja._, xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), [[46-1-corinthians.14.5|1Co.14:5 15:2]], [[54-1-timothy.5.19|1Ti.5:19]].

**εἰ**, 
_conjunctive particle_, used in conditions and in indirect questions.

1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; 
(a) pres.: before indic, pres., [[40-matthew.11.14|Mat.11:14]], [[45-romans.8.25|Rom.8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[41-mark.4.23|Mrk.4:23 9:22]], [[43-john.15.18|Jhn.15:18]], [[46-1-corinthians.7.9|1Co.7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[42-luke.16.31|Luk.16:31]], [[45-romans.8.11|Rom.8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[40-matthew.12.26|Mat.12:26]], [[45-romans.4.14|Rom.4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[42-luke.17.6|Luk.17:6]], [[43-john.8.39|Jhn.8:39]]; before quæst., [[40-matthew.6.23|Mat.6:23]], [[43-john.5.47|Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[60-1-peter.2.20|1Pe.2:20]]; 
(b) fut.: [[40-matthew.26.33|Mat.26:33]], [[60-1-peter.2.20|1Pe.2:20]]; 
(with) pf.: [[43-john.11.12|Jhn.11:12]], [[45-romans.6.5|Rom.6:5]], al.; 
(d) aor.: [[42-luke.16.11|Luk.16:11 19:8]], [[43-john.13.32|Jhn.13:32, 18:23]], [[66-revelation.20.15|Rev.20:15]], al. 
2. **Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί**: [[40-matthew.12.28|Mat.12:28]], [[43-john.7.4|Jhn.7:4]], [[45-romans.5.17|Rom.5:17]], al. 
3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).

As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[40-matthew.26.63|Mat.26:63]], [[41-mark.15.36|Mrk.15:36]], [[44-acts.19.2|Act.19:2]], [[47-2-corinthians.13.5|2Co.13:5]], al.; fut., [[41-mark.3.2|Mrk.3:2]], [[44-acts.8.22|Act.8:22]], al.; aor., [[41-mark.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[46-1-corinthians.1.16|1Co.1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, _Pr._, 194), [[50-philippians.3.12|Php.3:12.]]

1537:
**ἐκ** (ἐξ), 
_prep. with genitive, _ 
**from out of, from** (_see_ Addendum, p. 492).
This entry is included here, but in the print version the entry is found on p. 492. **ἐκ**, before a vowel ἐξ, 
_prep. with genitive, _ 
of motion outwards, separation from (opposite to εἰς; = Lat. e, ex), **from out of, from among, from**. 
I. Of Place, 
1. **of motion, out of, forth from, off from**: [[43-john.6.31|Jhn.6:31]], [[44-acts.9.3|Act.9:3]], [[48-galatians.1.8|Gal.1:8]], al.; esp. after verbs of motion, [[40-matthew.8.28|Mat.8:28 17:9]], [[41-mark.1.25|Mrk.1:25 7:28]], [[43-john.1.33|Jhn.1:33 20:1]], [[44-acts.12.7|Act.12:7, 17 27:30]], al.; constr. praeg., σώζειν (διας) ἐκ, Ju 5, [[44-acts.28.4|Act.28:4]]. Metaphorical, [[40-matthew.7.4|Mat.7:4]], 5, [[60-1-peter.2.9|1Pe.2:9]]; ἐκ τ. χειρός (-ῶν), before genitive of person(s), [[42-luke.1.74|Luk.1:74]], [[43-john.10.28|Jhn.10:28, 29, 39]], [[44-acts.12.4|Act.12:4 24:7]], [[66-revelation.19.2|Rev.19:2]]; πίνειν (which see) ἐκ; of the place from which an action proceeds, [[42-luke.5.3|Luk.5:3]] ([[42-luke.12.36|cf. 12:36]], [[43-john.13.4|Jhn.13:4]], [[47-2-corinthians.2.4|2Co.2:4]]). 
2. **Of change from one place or condition to another**: [[43-john.8.42|Jhn.8:42]], [[45-romans.6.13|Rom.6:13 13:11]], [[66-revelation.7.14|Rev.7:14]], al.; with ellips. of verb of motion, [[55-2-timothy.2.26|2Ti.2:26]], [[61-2-peter.2.21|2Pe.2:21]], [[66-revelation.2.21|Rev.2:21]], al.
3. Of separation or distinction from a number, before collective or pl. nouns: [[40-matthew.13.47|Mat.13:47, 49]], [[43-john.12.1|Jhn.12:1]], [[44-acts.3.15|Act.3:15]], [[60-1-peter.1.3|1Pe.1:3]], al.; after εἷς, [[40-matthew.10.29|Mat.10:29]] [[42-luke.17.15|Luk.17:15]], al.; οὐδείς, [[43-john.7.19|Jhn.7:19]], al.; πολλοί, [[43-john.11.19|Jhn.11:19]], al.; τις, [[42-luke.11.15|Luk.11:15]], al.; τίς, [[40-matthew.6.27|Mat.6:27]], al.; in partitive phrase as subject of sentence, [[43-john.16.17|Jhn.16:17;]] Hebraistically, ἐκ μέσου before genitive, = ἐκ (Heb. מִתּוֹךְ), [[40-matthew.13.49|Mat.13:49]], al. 
4. **Of position or direction **(so in cl. = ἔξω): ἐκ δεξιῶν (see: δεξιός); ἐξ ἐναντίας, [[41-mark.15.39|Mrk.15:39]] (metaphorically, [[56-titus.2.8|Tit.2:8]]); ἐκ ῥιζῶν (i.e., **utterly**), [[40-matthew.11.20|Mat.11:20.]]

1. of the point of time from which, **from, since**: ἐκ γενετῆς, [[43-john.9.1|Jhn.9:1]], cf. [[41-mark.10.20|Mrk.10:20]], [[42-luke.23.8|Luk.23:8]], [[44-acts.24.10|Act.24:10]], al.

2. **Of the author, occasion or source**: [[40-matthew.5.37|Mat.5:37]], [[43-john.2.16|Jhn.2:16]], [[45-romans.2.29|Rom.2:29]], [[46-1-corinthians.8.6|1Co.8:6]], [[48-galatians.5.8|Gal.5:8]], al.; ἐκ (τ. θεοῦ, [[46-1-corinthians.7.7|1Co.7:7]], [[47-2-corinthians.5.1|2Co.5:1]], [[62-1-john.4.7|1Jn.4:7]]; ἐκ τ. πατρός, [[43-john.6.65|Jhn.6:65]], al.; ἐκ τ. γῆς ἐστιν, λαλεῖ, [[43-john.3.31|Jhn.3:31;]] εκ καρδίας, [[45-romans.6.17|Rom.6:17]], cf. [[41-mark.12.30|Mrk.12:30]], [[54-1-timothy.1.5|1Ti.1:5]]; ἐκ ψυχῆς, [[49-ephesians.6.6|Eph.6:6]], [[51-colossians.3.23|Col.3:23]]; ἐκ πίστεως, [[45-romans.14.23|Rom.14:23;]] κρίνειν ἐκ, [[42-luke.19.22|Luk.19:22]], [[66-revelation.20.12|Rev.20:12]]. 
3. **Of the agent, after passive verbs**: [[40-matthew.15.5|Mat.15:5]], [[41-mark.7.11|Mrk.7:11]], [[47-2-corinthians.2.2|2Co.2:2]], al.; frequently in Re after αδικεῖσθαι (2:11), etc. 
4. **Of cause, dependence, source of supply**: τ. πόνου (των), [[66-revelation.16.10|Rev.16:10, 11]]; τ. φωνῶν, [[66-revelation.8.13|Rev.8:13;]] ἐκ τούτου, [[43-john.6.66|Jhn.6:66 19:12]] (but see Meyer, in ll.); ἐκ θεοῦ λαλεῖν, [[47-2-corinthians.2.17|2Co.2:17;]] ἐκ τ. ἀληθείας, [[43-john.18.37|Jhn.18:37]], [[62-1-john.3.19|1Jn.3:19]]; ὁ ἐκ πίστεως, [[45-romans.3.26|Rom.3:26 4:16]]; οἱ (ὄντες) ἐκ περιτομῆς, [[44-acts.11.2|Act.11:2]], [[45-romans.4.12|Rom.4:12]], [[48-galatians.2.12|Gal.2:12]], [[51-colossians.4.11|Col.4:11]]; πίνειν ἐκ, [[40-matthew.26.29|Mat.26:29]], [[41-mark.14.25|Mrk.14:25]], [[43-john.4.13|Jhn.4:13]], al.; θερίζειν, [[48-galatians.6.8|Gal.6:8;]] μετέχειν ἐκ (= partit. genitive), [[46-1-corinthians.10.13|1Co.10:13;]] with inf., ἐκ τοῦ ἔχειν, [[47-2-corinthians.8.11|2Co.8:11.]] 
5. **Of material**: [[40-matthew.27.29|Mat.27:29]], [[43-john.2.15|Jhn.2:15 19:2]], [[45-romans.9.21|Rom.9:21]], [[46-1-corinthians.11.12|1Co.11:12]], [[66-revelation.18.12|Rev.18:12]], al.; allied to which is its use of price (= cl. genitive): [[40-matthew.27.7|Mat.27:7]], cf. [[40-matthew.20.2|ib. 20:2]], [[44-acts.1.18|Act.1:18]]. 
IV. **By attraction = ἐν **(cl.): τὰ ἐκ τ. οἰκιας, [[40-matthew.24.17|Mat.24:17;]] τ. ἐξ αὐτοῦ δύναμιν, [[41-mark.5.30|Mrk.5:30]] (see Field, in l.); ὁ πατὴρ ὁ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, [[42-luke.11.13|Luk.11:13.]] 
V. **Adverbial phrases**: ἐξ ἀνάγκης, [[47-2-corinthians.9.7|2Co.9:7]], [[58-hebrews.7.12|Heb.7:12]]; ἐξ ἰσότητος, [[47-2-corinthians.8.13|2Co.8:13;]] ἐκ μέρους, [[46-1-corinthians.12.27|1Co.12:27 13:9-12]]; ἐκ μέτρου, [[43-john.3.34|Jhn.3:34;]] ἐκ συμφώνου, [[46-1-corinthians.7.5|1Co.7:5.]] 
VI. in composition, ἐκ signifies, 
1. **procession, removal**: ἐκβαίνω, ἐκβάλλω. 
2. **Opening out, unfolding**: ἐκτείνω; metaphorically, ἐξαγγάλλω. 
3. **Origin**: ἔκγονος. 
4. **Completeness**: ἐξαπορέω (see M, _Pr._, 237), ἐκπληρόω, ἐκτελέω.

Of the agent, instrument or means (an extension of cl. ἐν of instr.—see LS, see word Ill—corresponding to similar use of Heb. בְּ), **by, with**: ἐν ὑμῖν κρίνεται ὁ κόσμος (= cl. παρά, C. dative), [[46-1-corinthians.6.2|1Co.6:2;]] ἐν τ. ἄρχοντι τ. δαιμονίων, [[40-matthew.9.34|Mat.9:34;]] ἐν αἵματι, [[58-hebrews.9.22|Heb.9:22;]] ἐν ὕδατι, [[40-matthew.3.11|Mat.3:11]], al.; ἐν μαχαίρᾳ ἀποκτενεῖ (cf. the absol. ἐν μ., ἐν ῥάβδῳ, supr., II, which some would classify here), [[66-revelation.13.10|Rev.13:10]] ([[66-revelation.6.8|cf. 6:8]]). (a) **in** or **during** a period: ἐν τ. ἡμέρᾳ (νυκτί), [[43-john.11.9|Jhn.11:9]], al.; ἐν σαββάτῳ, [[40-matthew.12.2|Mat.12:2]], al.; ἐν τῷ μεταξύ, **meanwhile**, [[43-john.4.31|Jhn.4:31;]] 
(b) **at the time of an event**: ἐν τ. παρουσίᾳ, [[46-1-corinthians.15.23|1Co.15:23;]] ἐν τ. ἀναστάσει, [[40-matthew.22.28|Mat.22:28;]] 
(with) with art. inf., 
(α) present (so sometimes in cl., but not as in NT = ἕως; V. M, _Pr._, 215), **while**: [[40-matthew.13.4|Mat.13:4]], [[41-mark.6.48|Mrk.6:48]], [[48-galatians.4.18|Gal.4:18]], al.; 
(β) aor., **when, after**: [[42-luke.9.36|Luk.9:36]], al.; 
(d) **within** (cl.): [[40-matthew.27.40|Mat.27:40]], 
V. **In composition**: (1) meaning: (a) with adjectives, it signifies usually the possession of a quality, as ἐνάλιος, ἐν́δοξος; (b) with verbs, continuance in (before ἐν) or motion into (before εἰς), as ἐμμένω, ἐμβαίνω. (ii) Assimilation: ἐν becomes ἐμ- before β, μ, π, φ, ψ; ἐγ- before γ, κ, ξ, χ; ἐλ- before λ. But in the older MSS of NT, followed by modern editions, assimilation is sometimes neglected, as in ἐνγράφω, ἐγκαινίζω, etc.

**ἐπί** (before a smooth breathing ἐπ᾽, before a rough breathing ἐφ᾽), 
_prep._ with genitive, dative, accusative (accusative most frequently in NT), 
with primary sense of superposition, **on, upon**. 
I. C. genitive, 
1. of place, answering the question, where? 
(a) of the place on which, **on, upon**: ἐπὶ (τ.) γῆς, [[40-matthew.6.10|Mat.6:10, 19]], al.; τ. κεφαλῆς, [[46-1-corinthians.11.10|1Co.11:10;]] τ. νεφελῶν, [[40-matthew.24.3|Mat.24:3]]o, al.; like ἐν, in constr. praegn. after verbs of motion: βάλλειν, [[41-mark.4.26|Mrk.4:26;]] σπείρειν, ib. 31; ἔρχεσθαι, [[58-hebrews.6.7|Heb.6:7]], al.; figuratively, ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας (MM, see word ἀ.); of the subject of thought or speech, [[48-galatians.3.16|Gal.3:16;]] of power or authority, **over**, πάντων, [[45-romans.9.5|Rom.9:5:]] τ. γάζης, [[44-acts.8.27|Act.8:27;]] ἐξουσία, [[66-revelation.2.26|Rev.2:26 20:6]]; 
(b) of vicinity, **at, by**: τ. θαλάσσης, [[43-john.6.9|Jhn.6:9;]] τ. ὁδοῦ, [[40-matthew.21.19|Mat.21:19;]] τοῦ βάτου, [[41-mark.12.26|Mrk.12:26]] (see Swete, in l.); with genitive of person(s), **in the presence of, before**, [[40-matthew.28.14|Mat.28:14]], [[44-acts.23.30|Act.23:30]], [[46-1-corinthians.6.1|1Co.6:1]], al. 
2. Of time, 
(a) with genitive of person(s), **in the time of**: ἐπὶ Ἐλισαίου, [[42-luke.4.27|Luk.4:27;]] ἐπὶ Κλαυδίου, [[44-acts.11.28|Act.11:28;]] ἐπὶ Ἀβιάθαρ ἀρχιερέως, **when A. was high priest**, [[41-mark.2.26|Mrk.2:26;]] 
(b) with genitive of thing(s), **at, at the time of**: [[40-matthew.1.11|Mat.1:11]], [[58-hebrews.1.2|Heb.1:2]], [[61-2-peter.3.3|2Pe.3:3]]; ἐπὶ τ. προσευχῶν, [[45-romans.1.10|Rom.1:10]], [[49-ephesians.1.16|Eph.1:16]], [[52-1-thessalonians.1.2|1Th.1:2]], Phm 4. 
II. C. dative, of place, answering the question, where? 
(a) lit., **on, upon**: [[40-matthew.9.16|Mat.9:16, 14:8]], al.; after verbs of motion (see supr., I, 1, (_a_)), [[40-matthew.9.16|Mat.9:16]] [[44-acts.8.16|Act.8:16]]; **above**, [[42-luke.23.38|Luk.23:38;]] **at, by**, [[41-mark.13.29|Mrk.13:29]], [[43-john.5.2|Jhn.5:2]], [[44-acts.5.9|Act.5:9]], al.; 
(b) metaphorically, **upon, on the ground of**, [[42-luke.4.4|Luk.4:4]] (LXX); **in the matter of**, [[41-mark.6.52|Mrk.6:52]] (see Swete, in l.); **upon, of, concerning**, [[44-acts.5.35|Act.5:35, 40]]; of the ground, reason or motive (Bl., §38, 2; 43, 3), [[40-matthew.18.3|Mat.18:3 19:9]], [[45-romans.12.12|Rom.12:12]], al.; ἐφ᾽ ᾧ, **for the reason that, because**, [[45-romans.5.12|Rom.5:12]] [[47-2-corinthians.5.4|2Co.5:4]]; after verbs of motion, **over**, [[40-matthew.18.13|Mat.18:13]], [[45-romans.16.19|Rom.16:19]], al.; of a condition (cl.), [[45-romans.8.20|Rom.8:20]], [[46-1-corinthians.9.10|1Co.9:10]]; ἐπὶ δυσὶ μάρτυσιν (see Westc. on [[58-hebrews.9.10|Heb.9:10]]), [[58-hebrews.10.28|Heb.10:28]]; of purpose or aim, [[49-ephesians.2.10|Eph.2:10]], [[50-philippians.4.10|Php.4:10]]; of authority, **over**, [[40-matthew.24.47|Mat.24:47]] [[42-luke.12.44|Luk.12:44]]; of hostility, with dative of person(s) (cl.), **against**, [[42-luke.12.52|Luk.12:52;]] **in addition to** (cl.), [[47-2-corinthians.7.13|2Co.7:13;]] of an adjunct, **in, at, on**, [[50-philippians.1.3|Php.1:3 2:17]]. 
III. C. accusative, 
1. of place of motion upon or over, answering the question, whither? 
(a) lit., **upon, over**: [[40-matthew.14.28|Mat.14:28, 29]], [[42-luke.5.19|Luk.5:19]], al. mult.; in NT also, answering the question, where? (as with genitive, dative), [[41-mark.4.38|Mrk.4:38 11:2]], [[42-luke.2.25|Luk.2:25]], [[43-john.1.32|Jhn.1:32]]; ἐπὶ τ. αὐτό, [[44-acts.1.15|Act.1:15 2:1]], al.; of motion to a vicinity, **to**, [[41-mark.16.2|Mrk.16:2]], [[44-acts.8.36|Act.8:36]], al.; 
(b) metaphorically (in wh. "the accusative is more widely prevalent than it strictly should be," Bl., §43, 1); of blessings, evils, etc., coming upon one, with accusative of person(s), [[40-matthew.10.13|Mat.10:13 12:28]], [[44-acts.2.17|Act.2:17]], [[43-john.18.4|Jhn.18:4]], [[49-ephesians.5.6|Eph.5:6]], al.; of addition (dative in cl.), λύπη ἐπὶ λύπην, [[50-philippians.2.27|Php.2:27;]] ἐπικαλεῖν ὄνομα ἐπί (see: ἐπικαλέω), [[44-acts.15.17|Act.15:17]], [[59-james.2.7|Jas.2:7]]; καλεῖν ἐπί, **to call after**, [[42-luke.1.59|Luk.1:59;]] of number or degree: ἐπὶ τρίς (cl. εἰς τ.), **thrice**, [[44-acts.10.16|Act.10:16 11:10]]; ἐπὶ πλεῖον, **the more, further**, [[44-acts.4.17|Act.4:17]] [[55-2-timothy.2.16|2Ti.2:16 3:9]] (see also infr., 2, (_a_)); ἐφ᾽ ὅσον (see infr., ib.), **forasmuch as**, [[40-matthew.25.40|Mat.25:40, 45]], [[45-romans.11.13|Rom.11:13]]; of power, authority, control, [[42-luke.1.33|Luk.1:33]], [[44-acts.7.10|Act.7:10]] [[45-romans.5.14|Rom.5:14]], [[58-hebrews.3.6|Heb.3:6]], al.; of the direction of thoughts and feelings, **unto, towards**, [[42-luke.1.17|Luk.1:17 23:28]], [[44-acts.9.35|Act.9:35, 42]], [[45-romans.11.22|Rom.11:22]], [[48-galatians.4.9|Gal.4:9]], [[49-ephesians.2.7|Eph.2:7]], [[54-1-timothy.5.5|1Ti.5:5]], al.; of purpose, **for**, [[40-matthew.3.7|Mat.3:7]], [[42-luke.23.48|Luk.23:48]]; ἐφ᾽ ὅ πάρει (Rec. ἐφ᾽ ᾧ, [[40-matthew.26.50|Mat.26:50;]] of hostility, **against**, [[40-matthew.24.7|Mat.24:7]], [[41-mark.3.24|Mrk.3:24-26 10:11 13:8]], [[42-luke.9.5|Luk.9:5]], [[43-john.13.18|Jhn.13:18]], [[44-acts.7.54|Act.7:54]], [[46-1-corinthians.7.36|1Co.7:36]], [[47-2-corinthians.1.23|2Co.1:23]]; Of reference, **concerning, for** (cl. usually dative), [[41-mark.9.12|Mrk.9:12 15:24]], [[43-john.19.24|Jhn.19:24]], [[45-romans.4.9|Rom.4:9]]. 
2. Of time, 
(a) **during, for**: [[42-luke.4.25|Luk.4:25]] (WH, txt., omits ἐπί), [[44-acts.13.31|Act.13:31 16:18]], [[58-hebrews.11.30|Heb.11:30]], al.; ἐφ᾽ ὅσον (χρόνον), **as long as, for so long time as**, [[41-mark.9.15|Mrk.9:15]] [[45-romans.7.1|Rom.7:1]], al. (for ἐφ᾽ ὅ in another sense, see supr., 1, (_b_)); ἐφ᾽ ἱκανόν (see: ἱ), [[44-acts.20.11|Act.20:11;]] ἐπὶ πλεῖον (see supr., 1, (b)), **yet longer, further**, [[44-acts.20.9|Act.20:9 24:4]]; 
(b) **on, about, towards** (cl. εἰς): [[42-luke.10.35|Luk.10:35]] [[44-acts.3.1|Act.3:1 4:5]]. 
IV. **In composition, ἐπί signifies**: **up**, ἐπαίρω; **upon**, ἐπίγειος, ἐπιδημέω, ὠπικαθίζω; **towards**, επιβλέπω, ὠπεκτείνω; **over** (of superintendence), ἐπιστάτης; **again, in addition**, ἐπαιτέω; **against**, ἐπιορκέω, ἐπιβουλή.
